scientific_integrity: Original algebra is independently reconstructed from the open source equations and checked by reproducible symbolic/rational assertions. Related prior multiple-equilibrium results in different models are acknowledged. No independent review or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-equilibrium iff theorem is restricted to e=1 and gamma=eta in the stated diffusion-free ODE. Local persistence under full-parameter perturbations is proved only near a hyperbolic rational example. No global basin, spatial pattern, or real-world population outcome is inferred.
title: A sharp harvesting interval with two stable coexistence states in a weak-Allee predator–prey model
